profile.aggregate_rule: sum > 0 implies maximum > 0 in the same aggregate
profile.duration_rule: duration_sum > 0 implies positive distinct external-IP, source-port and destination-port counts in the same bucket
profile.clean_control_scope: All 143046 native train/development-prefix records, by partition, label and float64/float32 precision. Stop on any violation; do not filter or tune.
profile.repair: Restore complete native mutable dependency blocks implicated by a failed added rule to their own original values. Endpoint counts are immutable. Do not invent observed connections.
profile.generation_scope: New hard repair operates before every MOEVA population fitness evaluation. CAPGD inner gradient iterations remain unchanged; its outputs face the added outer-stage selector and final gates.
profile.comparison: Unchanged CAA generation plus the common final filter; budget/profile end repair; native-relationship/budget/profile end repair; budget/profile in-loop repair; native-relationship/budget/profile in-loop repair.
profile.final_selection: Deduplicate changed native-valid in-budget candidates per original; require both added rules; rank successful evasions by malicious score, distance and stable provenance. Recheck assembled final matrix and try the next candidate if rejected.
profile.fairness: Require identical pre-MOEVA arrays, MOEVA original IDs/population size and core model-forward counts relative to a fresh original CAA run. Count repair and post-selection cost separately. No equal-wall-time or equal-total-query claim.
limitations: Development profile motivated by earlier inspected candidates, not an independent test or a novelty claim.
Necessary feature conditions do not establish packet realizability or preserved malicious behavior.
Exact reproduction of the pinned CSV from the inspected extractor remains unestablished.
The frozen compatibility scaler used all feature rows in the original experiment; this inherited limitation remains.
Repeated attack seeds reuse the same selected originals; they are not independent traffic samples.
Conservative rollback can collapse proposals into duplicate or clean vectors.
Native test rows are not parsed or scored; full asset bytes are hashed for integrity.
No new IDS training, packet replay or classification threshold tuning.

protocol.cost_note: Core generation counts must match. End methods share original generation/evaluation. Postprocessing counters are incremental in this shared audit, not standalone runtime estimates. No equal-total-compute claim.

independent_review.scope: All exported native masks, rule masks, distances and classes recomputed; pools independently deduplicated; final provenance/validity/evasions checked. Intermediate fitness vectors are not exported: generation logs and matching repair/evaluation digests are cross-checked, not reconstructed.

validation_context.validation_mode: six full-budget model/seed pairs, three concurrent workers, then assembled and independently reviewed
validation_context.sequential_attempt: Earlier sequential execution was interrupted during its first pair; its partial output was not used in the completed comparison.
validation_context.generation: Cell 8 runner executed through its explicit --pair interface six times at full settings; no --smoke in the completed evidence.

interpretation: Small development pilot. Necessary conditions only; no packet-realizability, preserved-maliciousness, novel-method, or improved-IDS claim.
